problem_statement: SME freight forwarders in Malaysia spend hours per shipment manually re-keying invoice data between email, spreadsheets, and customs portals. Errors cost penalties.
solution: An agent that reads incoming invoice PDFs, extracts fields, validates them against the shipment manifest, and files the customs form. Built with a Qwen model plus browser tooling.
A reminder bot that syncs with the campus calendar and escalates overdue deadlines to study groups.

problem_statement: Small furniture workshops price custom orders by gut feel, losing margin on complex jobs.
solution: An estimating agent: upload a sketch or measurements, it decomposes the build into materials and labour steps, checks supplier price lists via tools, and outputs an itemised quote with margin options.
